subject.title: fix: wire tailscale_authkey and set operator for serve mode

question: Should the installer preserve an already configured Tailscale OperatorUser, or may it replace that user with openclaw during upgrades?
rationale: OperatorUser controls a privileged Tailnet boundary. The correct upgrade policy determines whether the PR must preserve existing setup, add an explicit override setting, or intentionally force a migration.

options.title: Preserve existing operator
options.body: Set openclaw only when OperatorUser is empty and leave a non-empty value untouched; this is the safest upgrade default.

options.title: Add explicit override
options.body: Preserve existing operators by default but add a clearly documented opt-in variable for administrators who want the role to replace it.

options.title: Force migration to openclaw
options.body: Always replace the operator and document the breaking upgrade behavior, accepting that existing non-root operators lose access.

recommendation.title: Preserve existing operator
recommendation.body: Set openclaw only when OperatorUser is empty and leave a non-empty value untouched; this is the safest upgrade default.
